subject: A review of 350+ studies tied lower protein intake to better metabolism
script: From Agewell Brief: A review of 350+ studies tied lower protein intake to better metabolism. A sweeping analysis of over 350 studies suggests that many sedentary people may be consuming more protein than they need, and that cutting back could improve metabolism and reduce inflammation. But experts caution that the right amount depends on age and activity level. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
